sentences.en: This is a daily today.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日今日》。

sentences.en: Both the Trump and Biden campaigns are quietly preparing for the possibility of a contested election next week that could involve recounts, lawsuits, and court cases.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和拜登的竞选团队都在悄悄为下周可能出现的选举争议做准备，这可能涉及重新计票、诉讼和法律案件。

sentences.en: My colleague Jim Rudenberg on what
sentences.zh: 我的同事吉姆·鲁登伯格将讲述

sentences.en: Democrats and Republicans have learned from the last time that happened.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和共和党人从上次发生这种情况中学到了什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月27日，星期二。

sentences.en: Jim, we are a week from the election.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，距离选举还有一周时间。

sentences.en: And it is an election that for a variety of reasons, the pandemic, the volume of mail-in balloting, questions about mail delivery, could end up being
sentences.zh: 由于各种原因，包括疫情、邮寄选票的数量、对邮件投递的质疑，这次选举最终可能会

sentences.en: bogged down in a lot of uncertainty and in legal disputes and could end up being contested.
sentences.zh: 陷入巨大的不确定性和法律纠纷中，并最终引发争议。

sentences.en: And the last time that that happened, that we had a contested presidential election, was in 2000.
sentences.zh: 而我们上一次经历有争议的总统选举是在2000年。

sentences.en: And just to start, what were you doing back then, the night of November 7th, 2000?
sentences.zh: 首先，2000年11月7日那天晚上，你在做什么？

sentences.en: Oh, God, it's like an acid flashback.
sentences.zh: 天哪，那感觉就像是一场迷幻的闪回。

sentences.en: Not that I would know what that is like.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我知道那是什么感觉。

sentences.en: But it was an insane night.
sentences.zh: 但那真是一个疯狂的夜晚。

sentences.en: I was a real cub, reporter covering the networks, covering the election night.
sentences.zh: 当时我还是个菜鸟记者，负责报道各大电视网，报道选举之夜。

sentences.en: Decision 2000.
There was so much pomp and circumstance around these election nights.
sentences.zh: 这些选举之夜总是充满了排场和仪式感。

sentences.en: It had become its own show.
sentences.zh: 它已经演变成了一场秀。

sentences.en: Good evening and welcome to what promises to be a long and exciting night.
sentences.zh: 晚上好，欢迎收看注定漫长而激动人心的一夜。

sentences.en: And it really became like this competition for bragging rights among the three broadcast networks.
sentences.zh: 它确实成了三大广播电视网之间争夺吹嘘资本的竞争。

sentences.en: Back at CBS News election headquarters in New York, the presidential race is cracking like a hickory fire here.
sentences.zh: 回到纽约的哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）新闻选举总部，总统竞选在这里像山核桃木火一样激烈。

sentences.en: NBC, CBS, ABC.
sentences.zh: NBC、CBS、ABC。

sentences.en: And with an enormous team of people all over the country tonight, we're going to try to make it fun and exciting.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我们拥有遍布全国的庞大团队，我们将努力让报道变得有趣且令人兴奋。

sentences.en: It is inherently exciting already.
sentences.zh: 它本身就已经足够令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: And we're sitting around, looking up at this big, old-fashioned TV, switching the channels with the remote and seeing who is going to call the presidency firSt.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在那里，抬头看着这台老式的大电视，用遥控器切换频道，看看谁会先宣布总统人选。

sentences.en: Now, the polls closed about an hour ago in two states, so we've already made some projections.
sentences.zh: 现在，两个州的投票站大约在一小时前关闭了，所以我们已经做出了一些预测。

sentences.en: Is it going to be Al Gore, the vice president, long-suffering under Bill Clinton, or is it going to be George W.
sentences.zh: 会是阿尔·戈尔吗？那位在比尔·克林顿手下长期忍受的副总统，还是乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush?
sentences.zh: 布什？

sentences.en: And here's the electoral vote count right at this moment.
sentences.zh: 这是此时此刻的选举人票统计结果。

sentences.en: 121 for Bush, 119 for Gore.
sentences.zh: 布什121票，戈尔119票。

sentences.en: And lo and behold...
sentences.zh: 瞧，结果来了……

sentences.en: We're going to now project an important win for vice president Al Gore, NBC News...
sentences.zh: 我们现在要宣布副总统阿尔·戈尔获得重要胜利，NBC新闻……

sentences.en: NBC at 7.50 p.m.
sentences.zh: NBC在晚上7点50分发布。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, really early.
sentences.zh: 所以，真的很早。

sentences.en: Wow, NBC.
sentences.zh: 哇，NBC。

sentences.en: Brokaw can tell you that...
sentences.zh: 布罗考可以告诉你……

sentences.en: NBC News projects that he wins the 25 electoral votes in the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: NBC新闻预测他赢得了佛罗里达州的25张选举人票。

sentences.en: Al Gore has won the state of Florida, and this is a big deal.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·戈尔赢得了佛罗里达州，这可是件大事。

sentences.en: This tells you, oh, Bush is in trouble.
sentences.zh: 这告诉你，哦，布什有麻烦了。

sentences.en: That is a very, very, very important state for Al Gore, and now the pressure is on George W.
sentences.zh: 这对阿尔·戈尔来说是一个非常、非常、非常重要的州，现在压力转移到了乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush in Pennsylvania and Michigan.
sentences.zh: 布什在宾夕法尼亚州和密歇根州的身上。

sentences.en: Now, there's a problem with this, and that's that there's a time difference, so the polls are actually closed at this point in most of Florida, but the panhandle,
sentences.zh: 现在，这有一个问题，那就是存在时差，所以此时佛罗里达州大部分地区的投票站已经关闭，但狭长地带，

sentences.en: which is very friendly to Bush, is still voting.
sentences.zh: 那里非常支持布什，还在投票。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But we are now able to make a projection in the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在能够对佛罗里达州做出预测。

sentences.en: The networks follow.
sentences.zh: 各大电视网纷纷跟进。

sentences.en: ABC News projects that Al Gore wins the state of Florida in its 25 electoral votes.
sentences.zh: 美国广播公司（ABC）新闻预测阿尔·戈尔赢得了佛罗里达州及其25张选举人票。

sentences.en: This is the biggest state where the race has been close.
sentences.zh: 这是竞选胶着的最大州。

sentences.en: Because when one calls, there's a lot of pressure in these newsrooms, this still exists today, to match that call.
sentences.zh: 因为当一家媒体做出预测时，新闻编辑室里会有很大的压力——这种情况今天依然存在——去跟进这一预测。

sentences.en: But yes, Gore has captured Florida.
sentences.zh: 但没错，戈尔拿下了佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: So, the Associated Press, ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox, they join in.
sentences.zh: 所以，美联社、ABC、CBS、CNN、福克斯，他们都加入了。

sentences.en: But the night wears on.
sentences.zh: 但夜色渐深。

sentences.en: Stand by, stand by.
sentences.zh: 待命，待命。

sentences.en: And something really strange happens.
sentences.zh: 然后发生了一件非常奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: CNN, right now, is moving our earlier declaration of Florida back to the too-close-to-call column.
sentences.zh: CNN现在将我们早些时候对佛罗里达州的宣布撤回，改回“胜负难料”一栏。

sentences.en: Ah.
sentences.zh: 啊。

sentences.en: CNN decides shortly before 10 o'clock, uh-oh, Florida, we really aren't so sure anymore.
sentences.zh: CNN在10点前不久决定，呃，佛罗里达州，我们真的不再那么确定了。

sentences.en: 25 very big electoral votes are hanging in the balance.
sentences.zh: 25张非常重要的选举人票悬而未决。

sentences.en: This no longer is a victory for Vice President Gore.
sentences.zh: 这不再是副总统戈尔的胜利了。

sentences.en: We're moving it back.
sentences.zh: 我们把它改回去了。

sentences.en: And then, one by one.
sentences.zh: 然后，一个接一个。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: First of all, I'm just going to call it back and say that we now believe that the state of Florida is too close to call.
sentences.zh: 首先，我要收回之前的说法，我们现在认为佛罗里达州的选情过于胶着，无法预测。

sentences.en: The other networks follow.
sentences.zh: 其他电视网也纷纷跟进。

sentences.en: Now, we're pulling it back into the undecided column because some bad data came.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们把它拉回未定状态，因为收到了一些错误的数据。

sentences.en: We now don't know what to make of Florida.
sentences.zh: 我们现在不知道该如何看待佛罗里达州了。

sentences.en: The true line that will live in infamy comes from Tom Brokaw.
sentences.zh: 那句将遗臭万年的名言出自汤姆·布罗考之口。

sentences.en: What the networks giveth, the networks taketh away.
sentences.zh: 电视网给予的，电视网也会收回。

sentences.en: NBC News is now taking Florida out of Vice President Gore's column and putting it back in the too-close-to-call column.
sentences.zh: NBC新闻现在将佛罗里达州从副总统戈尔的胜选栏中撤出，放回“胜负难料”一栏。

sentences.en: So now we've got this dangling appendage to the country, Florida, up for grabs.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们有了这个悬在国家身上的“附属物”——佛罗里达州，胜负未定。

sentences.en: We don't know what it's going to be.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道结果会怎样。

sentences.en: Let me tell you, I don't give people advice.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，我不给别人建议。

sentences.en: But if the kids haven't gone to sleep, get them in the room because people are going to be talking about this presidential race for a long time to come.
sentences.zh: 但如果孩子们还没睡，让他们进房间来，因为人们在很长一段时间内都会谈论这场总统竞选。

sentences.en: And something very, again, very interesting happens.
sentences.zh: 然后，又发生了一件非常、非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: As we're getting into the 2 a.m.
sentences.zh: 当我们进入凌晨2点时，

sentences.en: hour, Fox News makes the call.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻做出了预测。

sentences.en: Fox News now projects George W.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻现在预测乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush, the winner in Florida, and thus it appears, the winner of the presidency of the United States.
sentences.zh: 布什是佛罗里达州的赢家，因此看来，他也是美国总统的赢家。

sentences.en: Let me guess, almost everyone else follows.
sentences.zh: 让我猜猜，几乎所有其他人都跟进了。

sentences.en: Well, what do you know?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: Stop, please, Gary.
sentences.zh: 停下，拜托，加里。

sentences.en: Stop, stop.
sentences.zh: 停下，停下。

sentences.en: Gary, I apologize.
sentences.zh: 加里，我道歉。

sentences.en: We're going to make a projection now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要做出预测。

sentences.en: ABC News is now going to project that Florida goes to Mr. Bush.
sentences.zh: ABC新闻现在要预测佛罗里达州归布什先生所有。

sentences.en: NBC News projects that George Walker Bush, the new president of the United States.
sentences.zh: NBC新闻预测乔治·沃克·布什是美国新任总统。

sentences.en: Florida goes Bush.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州归布什。

sentences.en: The presidency is Bush.
sentences.zh: 总统之位属于布什。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: The networks have giveth again, and now they have giveth to George W.
sentences.zh: 电视网再次给予了，现在他们给予了乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush.
sentences.zh: 布什。

sentences.en: So, I've also gotten some important details before we hear from Vice President Gore about the details of the call that has occurred.
sentences.zh: 所以，在听到副总统戈尔关于这次通话细节的说明之前，我也得到了一些重要的细节。

sentences.en: Gore calls Bush with the traditional concession.
sentences.zh: 戈尔给布什打了电话，进行了传统的认输。

sentences.en: President-elect Bush telling the vice president, quote, you were a formidable opponent.
sentences.zh: 当选总统布什告诉副总统，引用他的话：“你是一位强大的对手。”

sentences.en: I know this is hard on your family.
sentences.zh: “我知道这对你的家人来说很艰难。”

sentences.en: Meaning that Bush had won the presidency.
sentences.zh: 这意味着布什赢得了总统大选。

sentences.en: So, you know, I decide I'm going to trudge through Times Square, get on the subway, go home.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我决定穿过时代广场，坐上地铁，回家。

sentences.en: What a night.
sentences.zh: 真是个不眠之夜。

sentences.en: And I come home to my apartment in Brooklyn, turn on the TV, because you want to keep following it, of course.
sentences.zh: 我回到布鲁克林的公寓，打开电视，因为你当然想继续关注它。

sentences.en: And, you know, you want to see the concession, you want to see the victory.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你想看到认输，你想看到胜利。

sentences.en: And lo and behold, I see a bunch of umbrellas outside of where Gore is going to speak in Nashville, pouring rain.
sentences.zh: 结果我看到戈尔在纳什维尔准备演讲的地方外面有一群雨伞，大雨倾盆。

sentences.en: And we haven't seen Vice President Al Gore.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有见到副总统阿尔·戈尔。

sentences.en: Perhaps they're waiting for all the votes to be counted, all the I's to be dotted, all the T's to be crossed.
sentences.zh: 也许他们正在等待所有选票清点完毕，所有细节都落实到位。

sentences.en: And he hasn't shown up.
sentences.zh: 但他还没有出现。

sentences.en: I've just gotten off the phone.
sentences.zh: 我刚挂断电话。

sentences.en: It is, in fact, true that the vice president has called to recant his concession.
sentences.zh: 副总统确实已经打电话撤回了他的认输。

sentences.en: And what we all learn is that Gore has decided against conceding because we see that the Florida results are still all up in the air.
sentences.zh: 我们所了解到的是，戈尔决定不认输，因为我们看到佛罗里达州的计票结果仍然悬而未决。

sentences.en: There are still disputes.
sentences.zh: 仍然存在争议。

sentences.en: Everybody is working the phones, trying to find out the latest on Florida.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在忙着打电话，试图找出佛罗里达州的最新情况。

sentences.en: The lead that Bush has is only in the hundreds.
sentences.zh: 布什的领先优势只有几百票。

sentences.en: So Gore apparently has erred in conceding.
sentences.zh: 所以戈尔显然在认输这件事上犯了错。

sentences.en: He calls Bush to take it back.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给布什收回认输。

sentences.en: And not surprisingly, George W.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush is displeased, to say the least, with Gore's renunciation of his own concession.
sentences.zh: 布什对戈尔撤回认输的行为感到非常不满，至少可以这么说。

sentences.en: The networks tonight, I think that it's fair to say we don't just have egg in our face.
sentences.zh: 今晚的电视网，我认为公平地说，我们不仅是丢脸了。

sentences.en: We've got omelet all over our suits at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，我们的西装上全是“蛋卷”。

sentences.en: And so the networks didn't only take it away as the networks have put Gore in a really bad position because having called it for Bush.
sentences.zh: 所以电视网不仅收回了预测，而且因为之前宣布布什获胜，他们让戈尔陷入了非常糟糕的境地。

sentences.en: Gore starts out from this place of he's the sore loser.
sentences.zh: 戈尔一开始就处于“输不起”的境地。

sentences.en: That's sort of an argument that the Bush people have.
sentences.zh: 这算是布什阵营的一种论调。

sentences.en: And it's one that's resonant.
sentences.zh: 而且这种论调很有共鸣。

sentences.en: So it shows you how important these media calls are.
sentences.zh: 所以这向你展示了这些媒体预测有多么重要。

sentences.en: I'm always reminded of those West Texas saloons where they had a sign that says, please don't shoot the piano player.
sentences.zh: 我总是想起那些西德克萨斯的酒吧，那里挂着一个牌子，上面写着：请不要向钢琴师开枪。

sentences.en: He's doing the best he can.
sentences.zh: 他已经尽力了。

sentences.en: And that's been pretty much the case here tonight with this election.
sentences.zh: 今晚的选举基本上就是这种情况。

sentences.en: We do the best we can on these calls.
sentences.zh: 我们在这些预测上尽了最大努力。

sentences.en: But we have to stand up and take responsibility and be accountable.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须站出来承担责任，并接受问责。

sentences.en: Right, because they are creating an on-the-ground dynamic, emotionally and otherwise, for the whole country.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为他们正在为整个国家创造一种实地动态，无论是情感上还是其他方面。

sentences.en: The whole gamut.
sentences.zh: 方方面面。

sentences.en: And so that's going to shape the rest of what's going to happen in Florida.
sentences.zh: 所以这将影响佛罗里达州接下来发生的一切。

sentences.en: So, Jim, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，吉姆，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: On November 8th, I assume a lot of the action is now in Florida.
sentences.zh: 11月8日，我想大部分行动现在都在佛罗里达州了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Let's begin our live team coverage in Tallahassee today where Rad Berkey is standing by.
sentences.zh: 让我们开始今天在塔拉哈西的现场团队报道，拉德·伯基正在那里待命。

sentences.en: Rad, if you throw a ball up in the air when it falls, it'll probably fall on an attorney today, right?
sentences.zh: 拉德，如果你把球扔到空中，当它落下时，今天它可能会掉在一个律师身上，对吧？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样。

sentences.en: So everybody heads down to Florida, and the two campaigns have very different imperatives.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都前往佛罗里达，两个竞选团队有着截然不同的迫切需求。

sentences.en: Gore needs votes counted.
sentences.zh: 戈尔需要清点选票。
